annotations.title: Hungarian Business ID & GIRO Checksum Validator API

description: Hungarian Business ID & GIRO Checksum Validator API: Validate Hungarian adószám, adóazonosító jel, cégjegyzékszám, and GIRO bank accounts offline (checksum/format only). (Endpoint: POST /v1/hu-business-validator)
